title: Late Tier Decision Credit (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a late tier-decision credit is added to a tier exception approval when the tier decision is made after it fell due.

The due date is the date of the latest supporting statement for the drug plus the formulary's standard decision time. That time is the formulary's standard decision hours divided by twenty-four, which is **72** hours, or 3 days, on every Northbridge formulary. The days late are the days from that statement date to the decision date, less those 3 days.

- At least **7** days late (the tier late week): **2** months are added.
- At least 1 day but fewer than 7 days late: **1** month is added.
- Otherwise: no late tier-decision credit is added.

The credit is added to the tier approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical statement received 3 June, due 6 June)

| Decision date | Days from the statement | Days late | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 June | 2 | none (decided early) | nothing |
| 6 June | 3 | 0 | nothing |
| 9 June | 6 | 3 | 1 month |
| 13 June | 10 | 7 | 2 months |
